rules.statement: To establish an estoppel, the action taken by the party seeking to establish the estoppel must be directly connected with the false impression caused by the representation or conduct of the party sought to be estopped.
rules.supporting_quote: "To establish an estoppel, it must be proved that the action taken by the party seeking to establish the estoppel was directly connected with the false impression caused by the representation or conduct of the party sought to be estopped."
